future_perturbation.procedure: Feed identical bars up to the decision bar; then append a radically different future bar. The decision at the decision bar must be bit-identical.

truncation_invariance.procedure: Truncate the fixture immediately after the decision bar (no future bars at all).
truncation_invariance.result: same ENTRY decision and SHORT direction

causal_inputs: rolling-z uses only [i-200, i) previous bars (current excluded)
no future bar, no future broker result, no future account state in either harness
execution identities are deterministic hashes, never wall-clock time
conclusion: No future leakage in the extracted TB strategy adapter.
